include.name: vue
include.description: Use when writing Vue 3 components and composables: `<script setup>` macros (defineProps, defineEmits, defineModel, defineSlots), refs, computed, watchers, lifecycle hooks, and Transition, Teleport, Suspense and KeepAlive.

include.name: vue-best-practices
include.description: Use before planning or building a Vue 3 app or feature, with or without Nuxt: a workflow for component boundaries, data flow, composables and state, then performance once behavior is correct. Prefers the Composition API with `<script setup>` and TypeScript.

include.name: vue-router-best-practices
include.description: Use when adding routes or navigation guards with Vue Router 4 or 5: async guards without `next()`, redirect loops, components that keep stale data when only the params change, and `beforeRouteEnter` without `this`.
